items.title: Add the G02 missing-row negative-control baseline smoke
items.context: Create a deterministic smoke for one 15-required-row parent roadmap ledger where 14 rows are fresh and closed but one required row is missing; the evaluator must report the missing row and block full completion.
items.userSees: Terminal shows parent-roadmap large-ledger G02 baseline smoke PASS and confirms one missing required row blocks full_roadmap_complete.
excludes: Do not modify parent-roadmap evaluator core logic

happy.desc: Running the G02 smoke reports 15 required rows, 14 generated closed rows, exactly 1 missing required row, and no full roadmap completion claim.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts the missing row is represented by missing_required_row and appears in openRows and invalidRows rather than being silently ignored.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts a full completion summary is blocked for G02 and local G02 proof does not set Authority, fullAuthority, production, or independent two-host completion claims.

items.title: Bind G02 baseline to documentation boundaries
items.context: Update the 10x15 baseline document so G01 and G02 are implemented, G03-G10 remain future, and the full 10x15 baseline is still not complete.
items.userSees: Documentation states G01 and G02 are implemented while G03-G10 remain future groups, and G02 is a missing-row negative control that blocks full completion.
excludes: Do not state that the full 10x15 baseline is complete

happy.desc: The baseline document names G02 as implemented and includes the runnable G02 smoke command.

edge.desc: The document keeps G03-G10 marked as future groups and explicitly states the full 10x15 baseline is not complete.

adversarial.desc: Documentation wording does not convert local G02 proof into Authority, production, fullAuthority, or independent two-host claims.
